name: Missouri Basin Materials
old_description: Missouri Basin Materials is an all-encompassing concrete material supplier in the Midwest, from rebar fabrication to providing anchor bolts and safety equipment. We have supplied projects in North Dakota, Montana, Wyoming, South Dakota & further. Our estimating department can furnish you with a quote for your project or upcoming bid, doesn’t matter if it’s ring wall foundation or a water treatment plant.
about:
Missouri Basin Materials operates from Bismarck, North Dakota, serving as a concrete material supplier across the Midwest. The company provides rebar fabrication, anchor bolts, safety equipment, and a range of construction accessories to projects throughout North Dakota, Montana, Wyoming, and South Dakota.

The business combines a fabrication shop for reinforcing steel with a supply operation that stocks products from vendors such as Five Star Products, Newark Paperboard Products, Paragon Products, Polyguard Products, and various void form and forming systems. Its estimating department prepares quotes for projects ranging from ring wall foundations to water treatment plants, and the shop emphasizes quick turnaround on rebar fabrication and shop drawings.

Customers include general contractors, municipal agencies, and industrial builders working on infrastructure, commercial, and water treatment projects in the Upper Midwest. The company has supplied materials for ring wall foundations, water treatment plants, and other concrete-intensive structures across its service territory.

Missouri Basin Materials positions itself as a single-source provider for concrete-related materials, highlighting rapid rebar fabrication and shop drawing delivery as a key differentiator for contractors facing tight bid schedules.
